items.note: E retained. Increased prevalence raises PPV and lowers NPV at fixed sensitivity/specificity; A reverses both, B/C contradict the stem, and D ignores prevalence dependence.

B retained provisionally. Patient values, not surrogate preference, family vote or automatic life prolongation, govern substituted judgment. Best-interest reasoning is the fallback only when preferences cannot be inferred.
remaining: Verify jurisdiction-neutral surrogate terminology and current AMA locator before closure.

items.note: A retained provisionally. NPHS1 encodes nephrin; podocin, COL4A5, UMOD and PKD1 products correspond to distinct renal disorders. Source authorship/currentness still pending.
D retained provisionally. Factor XIII cross-links fibrin after formation, explaining delayed bleeding and normal routine clotting times. Other options act earlier and/or affect routine assays.
D retained provisionally. Anti-GQ1b fits Miller Fisher; GM1, P/Q calcium channel, AChR and AQP4 antibodies map to distinct syndromes. Strength preservation does not create a second offered answer.

E retained provisionally. ACVR1 gain-of-function unifies the phenotype; RYR1, dystrophin, COL1A1 and FGFR3 mechanisms do not. The extra biopsy warning requires direct source validation before closure.

E retained provisionally. The described noninvasive pattern supports ATTR rather than AL, HCM, hypertension or iron overload. The item does not distinguish wild-type from variant ATTR and does not claim to.
remaining: Freshly verify the current multisociety diagnostic algorithm, exact tracer-grade conditions and monoclonal-protein exclusion; do not rely only on StatPearls.

items.note: B retained provisionally. APC/MUTYH cause adenomatous polyposis, MLH1 mismatch-repair disease, and SMAD4 juvenile-polyposis phenotypes; none matches the full Peutz-Jeghers pattern.
C retained provisionally. TPO mediates iodide oxidation/organification; NIS uptake, thyroglobulin synthesis, lysosomal release and TSH-receptor binding are distinct steps.
A retained provisionally. The phenotype and biochemical pair fit adult Refsum disease; other choices produce different metabolites/clinical syndromes.

B retained provisionally. Lead-time, recall, ecological and verification biases do not describe residual first-period treatment effects. Historical methods source is unusually indirect and needs replacement.
remaining: Replace the BPH appendix with a direct trial-methods source and verify the exact washout/carryover locator.

items.note: C retained provisionally. OCTN2 mediates cellular uptake/renal conservation; CACT, CPT I/II and MCAD are distinct shuttle or oxidation steps.

E retained. Corrected the age-7 presentation from normal-timed adrenarche to premature adrenarche: isolated hair/odor without thelarche or growth acceleration still reflects adrenal zona-reticularis androgen precursors, but before age 8 merits the qualifier premature.
remaining: Directly source the distinction between premature adrenarche and central precocious puberty from a pediatric endocrine primary guideline before closure.

items.note: B retained provisionally. XIa activates IX; tissue-factor X activation, prothrombinase, factor-XIII cross-linking and thrombin cleavage occur elsewhere in the cascade. The absent aPTT value avoids asserting it is normal.

A retained provisionally. Replaced the artificially specific acetylcholine-vesicle distractor with the real dynein retrograde-transport process. Dynein transport, PMP22 compaction, SNARE fusion and lysosomal sphingolipid degradation remain distinct from spastin-mediated severing.
remaining: Archive a directly retrievable primary source for both spastin severing and dynein retrograde transport; NCBI Bookshelf returned CAPTCHA.

items.note: B retained provisionally. Desmin is muscle-specific intermediate filament; actin, myosin, tubulin and dystrophin complexes are distinct cytoskeletal systems.
D retained provisionally. Loss of the PKA regulatory subunit raises PKA activity; Ras-MAPK, Gs-alpha loss, JAK-STAT and ryanodine signaling do not explain the named gene.

C retained provisionally. Leptin is the adipocyte satiety signal; insulin, ghrelin, GLP-1 and cortisol have different sources/functions. Near-undetectable leptin prevents common-obesity hyperleptinemia from serving as a second explanation.
E retained provisionally. Tryptophan is the niacin precursor; cystine/arginine/lysine belong to another transport class and methionine is not the relevant niacin precursor.

D retained provisionally. OAT deficiency causes hyperornithinemia; the other metabolites correspond to separate inborn errors. This is a direct consequence item rather than a full pathway calculation.

A retained. Under the stated proportional-hazards assumption, HR 0.70 means a 30% lower group-level instantaneous hazard among those still event-free; it does not specify absolute risk, median time, odds or survival proportion.

C retained after current OHRP review. A capable child's required assent is absent; minimal risk and parental permission alone do not authorize enrollment under the stated protocol. No treatment refusal rule is imported into this research scenario.
remaining: The OHRP FAQ flags pre-2018 guidance context; verify the linked current 45 CFR 46.408 text before final closure.

items.note: A retained provisionally. Alpha-intercalated-cell V-type H+-ATPase failure fits; pendrin, proximal bicarbonate transport, ENaC and NKCC2 affect other nephron processes.
D retained provisionally. Absence of infections and giant leukocyte granules argues against Chediak-Higashi; other bleeding/albinism options explain only part of the phenotype.
D retained provisionally. PMP22 deletion causes haploinsufficiency; reciprocal duplication causes CMT1A, while sodium-channel, dystrophin and MFN2 mechanisms do not match the deletion.

limitations: All 25 stems, five options, answer keys, rationales and objectives were read individually; no structural test was counted as clinical audit.
Targeted fresh sources support only the explicitly bound claims. All-option source entailment, legacy locator/currentness, exact outline hierarchy and exhaustive originality remain open.
The 2025 MedlinePlus encyclopedia page is third-party A.D.A.M. content hosted by NLM and was inspected only; its stated reuse restriction was respected and no raw capture was made.
NCBI-hosted GeneReviews and StatPearls are not classified as federal-authored merely because NLM hosts them.
No drug-label evidence was needed; SetID is therefore not applicable.
No complete from-zero adversarial pass or independent blind pass is claimed.
